factor_definitions.near_field_or_edge_contact: at least one T0 accepted box touched a Thermal image edge
factor_definitions.far_field_small_subject: median accepted raw YOLO box area below 12 percent
factor_definitions.seated_or_lying_action_context: action-context reporting stratum only; never a route input
factor_definitions.gross_motion_action_context: gross-motion action reporting stratum only; never a sampling or route input

contract.timeline: Thermal-native natural order and normalized time only
contract.yolo_acceptance: confidence>=0.25 and raw bbox area ratio>=0.05
contract.yolo_context_expansion: 25 percent on each side clipped to Thermal bounds
contract.heat_motion: per-frame luminance top quartile plus adjacent uniform-frame difference p75; temporal union; 5x5 close; largest component; 25 percent expansion

localization_route_audit.coverage_proxy_note: Heat/motion coverage is measured against accepted YOLO boxes for diagnosis only; YOLO is not ground truth.

ir_thermal_outlier_summary.conclusion: Counts and boundaries identify partial-capture candidates but cannot distinguish sensor stop from export truncation without acquisition metadata.

frozen_preprocessing_decision.reason: universal decodable-trial coverage and action-context retention; avoids route-dependent crop failures in the first matched baseline
frozen_preprocessing_decision.sampling: 16 uniform normalized Thermal time targets; no motion-peak sampling; no IR indices
frozen_preprocessing_decision.short_trial_policy: retain canonical sample; repeat nearest Thermal source only for fixed tensor; emit source-uniqueness mask
